replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
We always try to follow the same guidelines but there is always some issues that are going to appear

1) Depending on the severity of the rules broken, a punishment is going to be given. This all has to do with judgement, and everyone person judges certain situations differently. It is not like we're all robots who are programmed to think about a situation the same way. Yes maybe we should have a more general punishment system but at the moment, it is what it is.

2) Previous offenders - If people break the same rules more then once, they often get a more severe punishment then before. This is something that should stay I belief. Otherwise people never learn. If people are repeat offenders, their next punishment should be more severe.

replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
Alright.
My reasoning..
So, throughout my long time on this server, spanning almost two years, I have seen many staff come and go. On McZone, the staff team was more organized, and professional in their job, at least, from what I saw.
Then, upon Avicus' release, the new staff applications where already in progress, and to my surprise, coincidentally a huge amount of overrated and popular users made it in, whilst there was next to no users that where more of the underrated type, I myself was under review, and never got reply, and to this day, I have never gotten a reply on my old application from the beginning of Avicus, but I digress.
The staff team of that time proved to be lacking of what it could be, and some of the staff members in particular stood out as being immature, and did not take their job seriously, along with swearing constantly on TeamSpeak, Again, something a staff should not have been doing seeing as that is the very thing you set out to stop.
Later on, we go to this new batch of staff members.
Some of them are some of the best choices of staff I have seen in a while, but some just boggle my mind. Some staff do not take their jobs seriously, and constantly prove to be immature, time and time again.
All the time, right before someone is about to be punished for hacking, staff usually have some witty punchline lke "Any last words?" unlike some staff members who follow the correct moral conduct by stating "Hacking is not tolerated on Avicus"
I myself was denied for "Immaturity" a matter that has been dealt with and discussed a while ago. Though, seeing as some staff members are very immature, it boggles me that they would have gotten in, and not myself, compared to them in level of immaturity. 
Some staff members in particular were very offensive on Team Speak, but were not punished, no not demoted, but promoted, it is strange to me that someone can show such a high level of immaturity that is not tolerated, and still qualify for promotion.
To end off, I have seen staff members being temporally demoted for things not tolerated, but promoted to moderator again, something they do wrong should result in a permanent demotion, which I have not seen in a very long time.
In conclusion, the staff tam, or rather, the staff system is a considerable amount more biased than what it used to be, in fact, confusing if you will. I suggest looking more deeper into the people who you are interested in staff, and be more strict towards people, that includes the staff.

I am deeply sorry if any of this offended you, and please feel free to give me your own opinion, heck, you can hate on my opinion as much as you please, just as long as you justify your reasoning for hating on it.

No names will or have been mentioned, and I intend to keep it that way.

I am also sorry to the staff team if I offended you.

replies.author: Trexychan
replies.body:
I honestly have to give avicus my most honest viewpoint. Here it goes:

Server: 88/100
I get ok ping (60-80), but every time I jitter-click block spam I get lagged back. I also feel that many games need a spark to get them interesting. Neb is most of the time the only game people play. I don't know how to get the other games more played, but I just feel that imbalance.
Players: 67/100
There are a lot of hackusators. Like. A lot a lot. It pains me to see that people can't take a loss. (though it is funny seeing someone with the notion he is pro call hacks on every person that kills him.) Not only these people, but there are the trolls, the people with mult. accounts, the hackers, etc. (Not to mention those who step in fornt of you while you're gettting a mon just so they can break it and take all the glory) However, there are just as many people on this server that I can actually cooperate with. Sometimes, whether it be a killfarm session or a mad rush for the monument, there's like this mental connection, so while one person is mining the mon, the other is defending them. In a kf, one person retreats back to heal, the other steps in to cover them. It's those moments of teamwork that is the key reason why I love playing on here.
Staff:76/100
I feel the same way like many when it comes to staff picking. I have mixed emotions, sometimes I feel these mods are good,  if not great, selections. BUT, like many others, I feel there is some bias when it comes to picking some. (not naming people or pointing fingers.) I feel that a lot of mods here are nice though, and that's what makes me happy.

Overall, my personal score for avi is 80-90. In all sincerity, this is my main pvp server. It was here where I got much significantly better at pvp. Thanks to you guys, I now can beat the ever-living snot out of people on an old pvp server. The people that I once considered "good" are nothing compared to you folks.

(This is probably the only long post I will ever make on these forums.)

(Oh yeah, I apologize if I did not suggest any improvements.)

replies.author: StewieFG
replies.body:
Server- 95/100: The server has really nice gameplay and unique game modes, other servers have probably not original game modes, like only survival games etc. Avicus provides amazing game modes with great gameplay, however the server lags sometimes and there are some issues, but I'm sure it will get fixed at the Nise Update.

Community- 90/100: Avicus has the best community I have seen from all thr servers I have played in my life. Nice and helpful people, they want the best for you and always there when you need them, also easy to make friends. However, I see a big difference between the community ingame and the community in the forums- the community in the forums are these nice and helpful part, don't get me wrong, the ingame community is great also, but there are some hackers, trollers, and rude people that sometimes ruin the fun. But it's a really little bit, I have always seen the good part of the community :)

Staff- 100/100: Yes, I know, I know they make mistakes, as everyone does, we are all human, and that's completely alright to make mistakes. 
I'm not overrating our staff, trust me. Our staff are the people who passed the interviews and the applications, which means they are the best people to do their job. No complaints about the choice, however you can complain about how they do their job, so they can improve.
The staff work super hard to make the server better, for all of those of you that got falsely punished or something like this, it's a resolution of a staff member that tried to help and didn't succeed, however the staff always try to make the server better so you, the community can enjoy the server.
I expect everyone to appreciate their hard work, and a couple of mistakes isn't a reason to down the rate, because no staff are perfect. So I'll give our amazing staff a solid 100/100 :)

Overal: 95/100 <3
